endpoint_labels.F: Unchanged selected pre-condition P/S fusion base

definitions.units: Input fractions; endpoint scores are percentages; paired differences and population SDs are percentage points.
definitions.aggregation: Equal case weight; undefined metrics excluded and case IDs listed; worst mean uses ceil(20% of defined cases).
definitions.reporting_priority: First report each revised endpoint minus F as the system-level net change; then AR_GDF-AR as the matched Gaussian-supervision contrast.
definitions.F_to_final: Additional condition and suffix training versus selected F; not a budget-matched isolated component ablation.
definitions.GDF_contrast: Two full-S arms start from one shared head checkpoint and use equal planned update budgets; only the declared GDF loss schedule differs.
definitions.scope: Fixed single seed native VAL8 only; no TEST, seed-stability or causal phase-localization claim.
definitions.native_GT_support: Reported native GT voxel/volume/skeleton/fine supports agree; voxelwise label-file hashes are not independently checked by this local aggregator.
definitions.centerline: Lee skeleton voxel overlap on each native grid; not physical branch length
definitions.fine_centerline: GT native Lee skeleton sites with native physical EDT radius <=2mm; report supported voxel count; no sites yields null recall
definitions.patch_comparison: Patch VAL64, CPU VAL16 and native whole-case metrics are distinct; GDF MSE reduction alone is not connectivity evidence.
